snippet.title: Mushroom Age - Trailer
snippet.description:
Help Vera track down her lost love!

Battle the forces of evil through challenging Hidden Object's search, Puzzles and time-twisting Mini-Games!
Explore world history first-hand and interact with ancient sages and fearsome, prehistoric predators. Save your fiance Tom, the world, and time itself in this expansive quest game!

Leave a like & subscribe if you like our videos ♥
